summary: Frontend Review Agent (Gate 8) reviewed PR #77 for NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability. Verdict: REQUEST CHANGES. 3 blocking issues found: (B1) useAutoSave passes hardcoded empty data instead of reading from sceneStore — auto-save is a no-op, (B2) package.json has out-of-scope breaking changes (removed immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8; major bumps to zustand v5, vite v6; removed scripts; changed package name), (B3) all 4 test files use inline stubs instead of importing real production modules — zero production code coverage. 5 medium non-blocking concerns also noted: async beforeunload, TOCTOU on saveCount, raw IDBKeyRange usage, missing focus trap, resetDBPromise without db.close(). Architecture, idb usage, atomic transactions, validation, accessibility attributes, and data-testid alignment are all correct.

blocking_issues.title: useAutoSave passes hardcoded empty data — auto-save is a no-op
blocking_issues.description: The interval callback passes bricks: [], hardcoded camera state, and placeholder metadata. Auto-save will always persist an empty scene. E2E test T-BE-REL-001-01 will fail.
blocking_issues.required_fix: Read actual scene state from sceneStore at save time using useSceneStore.getState()

blocking_issues.title: package.json has out-of-scope breaking changes
blocking_issues.description: Removed immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8. Major bumps: zustand 4→5, vite 5→6. Removed scripts: lint:fix, format, format:check, type-check, test:e2e:ui. Package name changed.
blocking_issues.required_fix: Revert package.json to base, only add idb and fake-indexeddb

blocking_issues.title: All test files use inline stubs instead of real imports
blocking_issues.description: Every test file defines its own inline implementation rather than importing production code. Tests provide false confidence — bugs in production code would not be caught.
blocking_issues.required_fix: Update test imports to use real production modules. Use resetDBPromise() for test isolation.

medium_concerns.title: markSessionClosed() is async but fire-and-forget in beforeunload
existingMeta read is outside the atomic transaction
purgeSession() uses raw IDBKeyRange.only() instead of idb wrapper
Missing focus trap and Escape key handler in ResumePrompt
resetDBPromise() doesn't close the existing connection

strengths: idb library usage per LLD Section 13
Atomic dual-store transaction pattern in saveSnapshot()
Singleton DB pattern with resetDBPromise() for testing
All data-testid attributes match E2E selectors
Accessible modal with role=dialog, aria-modal, aria-labelledby
Clean module separation and JSDoc documentation
Overlap guard with isSavingRef in useAutoSave

human_review_required.item: Gate 8: Approve or reject frontend-review verdict
human_review_required.reason: Human must confirm the 3 blocking issues before sending back to coding agent

recommended_actions: Fix B1: Update useAutoSave.ts to read actual scene state from sceneStore
Fix B2: Revert package.json to base, only add idb + fake-indexeddb + globals
Fix B3: Update all 4 test files to import real production modules
Address M1-M5 medium concerns if time permits
